abilities.name: Violet Edge
abilities.text: Rumi fights by listening to the breach-note behind a strike, letting the blade arrive where the enemy is about to be.

abilities.name: Glassmere Footwork
abilities.text: Mirror-lit routes and unstable crossings are less dangerous when Rumi has already danced through their reflections.

abilities.name: Rift-Flame Hand
abilities.text: When a Signal test turns hostile, Rumi can pull the failure into her palm and burn it down to a narrower risk.

abilities.name: Courtbreaker Smile
abilities.text: The Hollow Court expects fear. Rumi answers with a smile sharp enough to make masked nobles step back.
